name: com.nmj_gd.nmjtoolbox
description:
Helper scripts, runtime extensions and Editor tooling for Unity.

Runtime: inspector-driven object pooling built on UnityEngine.Pool, collection/string/parsing/UI Toolkit extension methods, a MonoBehaviour singleton base, a minimal state machine and a scene-path based SceneChanger.

Editor: batch rename with {token} expressions for the Hierarchy and Project window, Create/Dissolve Collection grouping, Mini Hierarchy and Inspector overlays for the Scene view, a state machine code generator, a project folder-structure scaffolder, AssetDatabase helpers, a transform reset hotkey, a grid instantiator, a reusable UI Toolkit list control and a component context-menu GameObject renamer.
